standard.summary: 每个 optimizer.step 后对可训练 LoRA/适配器参数加零均值高斯扰动（不碰底模）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Adds zero-mean Gaussian perturbation to the trainable LoRA/adapter parameters after every optimizer.step (the base model is left alone).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 每个 optimizer.step 后对可训练 LoRA/适配器参数加零均值高斯扰动（不碰底模）。默认关闭；小数据集抗过拟合/促 flat-minima 可试。

advanced_en.principle: Adds zero-mean Gaussian perturbations to trainable LoRA/adapter parameters after each optimizer.step (the base model is untouched). Off by default; worth trying on small datasets for anti-overfitting / flat-minima encouragement.
